value.title: The Daily Bugle#7
value.text: J. Jonah Jameson hires Betty Brant as an intern to run The Daily Bugle's social videos.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Betty's boss, who hires her as an intern.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Jameson's new intern, who runs the Bugle's TikTok.

split.title: The Daily Bugle#8
split.text: Jameson cuts Betty off when she calls Peter Parker a very nice person who saved her life.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Betty's boss, who hires her as an intern.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Jameson's intern, who speaks too kindly of Spider-Man.

verdicts.why: Betty is hired as the Bugle's intern in 'Hi TikTok!' (#7 overall), but Jameson first cuts her off for praising Peter in the next video (#8), so that fact is split out.
In #6 Sam, not Bucky, fights Batroc; Batroc then fires smoke grenades between the Flag Smashers and Sam, Bucky and Walker so they can flee. That is the pair's only scene.
Bucky is angry at the new Captain America and meets and rejects Walker in #2; Walker kills Nico at the end of #4 and Bucky and Sam take the shield in #5, as the split says.

value.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#2
value.text: Bucky Barnes and Sam Wilson start hunting Karli Morgenthau and her Flag Smashers. In their first clash she kicks Bucky off a moving truck with super soldier strength.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Leader of the Flag Smashers, a super soldier who kicks Bucky off a truck.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The Winter Soldier, hunting Karli with Sam.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
split.text: Bucky keeps hunting Karli across Europe with Sam and helps stop her final attack on the GRC in New York.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Leader of the Flag Smashers, a super soldier who kicks Bucky off a truck.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Winter Soldier, hunting Karli across Europe with Sam. Helps stop her final attack.

verdicts.why: They first clash in the Munich truck fight in #2, but the text also tells of the New York attack in #6, so that part is split out.
Walker and Lemar join Bucky and Sam in the Munich truck fight in #2, give them a ride and offer to team up, which Bucky turns down; the uneasy team-up starts there.

value.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#2
value.text: Eli Bradley is wary when Sam Wilson and Bucky first come to see his grandfather Isaiah, but he lets them in.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Falcon, whom Eli distrusts at first.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
split.text: Sam brings Eli and Isaiah to see Isaiah honored in the Captain America exhibit.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Falcon Eli distrusts at first, who later gets Isaiah honored in the exhibit.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Isaiah's grandson, wary at first, whom Sam brings to the exhibit.

verdicts.why: Eli first meets Sam at Isaiah's door in #2, but the exhibit visit is in #6, so it is split out.

value.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
value.text: Sharon Carter calls Georges Batroc, reminds him she got him out of prison in Algeria, and offers him double pay for a new job.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Frees Batroc from prison and hires him for a new job.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Mercenary Sharon frees from prison and hires.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
split.text: Sharon, revealed as the Power Broker, has Batroc spy on Karli Morgenthau. When he learns who she is and threatens to expose her, she shoots him dead.
split.on_a_card_about_b: As the Power Broker, frees and hires Batroc, then shoots him dead.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Mercenary Sharon frees and hires, then kills when he threatens to expose her.

verdicts.why: Sharon first calls Batroc with the job in #5, but that she is the Power Broker, that the job is spying on Karli, and his death all come in #6, so they are split out.

value.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#2
value.text: Bucky brings Sam Wilson to meet Isaiah Bradley, a forgotten Black super soldier the government imprisoned and experimented on. Isaiah refuses to help them and sends them away.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Falcon, who comes with Bucky and is sent away.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A forgotten super soldier who turns Sam away.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
split.text: Sam returns alone, and Isaiah tells him the full story of what was done to him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who comes back to hear Isaiah's story.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A forgotten super soldier Sam befriends.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
split.text: Sam has Isaiah's story added to the Captain America exhibit and brings him to see it.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who seeks Isaiah out and adds his story to the Captain America exhibit.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A forgotten super soldier Sam befriends, whose story he makes sure is told.

verdicts.why: They meet in #2, where Isaiah turns them away; Sam returns to hear his story in #5 and has it added to the exhibit in #6, so those facts are split out.
Walker first fights Karli's group in Munich in #2, Karli kills Lemar in Riga in #4, and in #6 Walker confronts her and she says his friend did not matter to her cause.
Valentina approaches Walker after his discharge hearing in #5, says powerful people are interested in him and asks him to stay in touch; she gives him the black suit and the name U.S. Agent in #6.
Sam first fights Karli's Flag Smashers in Munich in #2, talks with her alone after the funeral in Riga in #4, and she dies in his arms after Sharon shoots her in #6.
Lemar first helps Sam fight the Flag Smashers in #2. In #4 he urges Walker to give Sam's talk with Karli a chance and Sam saves him from Nomble, so 'at odds over Walker' is not supported.

value.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#3
value.text: Selby, a Madripoor crime boss, orders Sam, Bucky and Zemo killed when Sam's cover is blown, and Sharon shoots her from a sniper's perch.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The sniper who shoots Selby to save Sam and Bucky.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A Madripoor crime boss Sharon shoots to save Sam and Bucky.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
split.text: Sharon is revealed to be the Power Broker, Selby's secret boss in Madripoor.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Selby's secret boss, the Power Broker. Shoots Selby from a sniper's perch.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Sharon's agent in Madripoor. Sharon shoots her to save Sam and Bucky.

verdicts.why: Selby appears only in #3, where Sharon, the unseen sniper, shoots her. But Sharon is only revealed as the Power Broker in #6, so the boss part is split out to #6.

value.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
value.text: Sharon Carter is revealed as the Power Broker, who funded Wilfred Nagel's work on the serum.

verdicts.why: In #3 Nagel only says the Power Broker funded him, and Sharon just leads the others to his lab. The boss link to Sharon is first known when she is revealed as the Power Broker in #6.
Ayo gives Bucky eight hours in #4, and Zemo slips away while the Dora Milaje fight Walker. Ayo's team arrests him at the Sokovia memorial in #5, where she says they will take him to the Raft.
Frank and Amy move into a campervan Curtis provides in S2#5. Frank's 'just take care of the kid' request to Curtis comes in S2#7.
Billy escapes from the hospital in S2#3, and in the same episode Mahoney takes the case for the NYPD and turns Madani away.
In S1#13 Billy breaks into Curtis's apartment, threatens him to make him give up Frank, and shoots him in the shoulder. Before that they are still friends.
Billy shoots Madani in the head at the carousel in S1#13.

value.title: The Punisher S1#5
value.text: Billy Russo and Homeland Security agent Dinah Madani become lovers.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's lover, a Homeland agent looking into Frank's old unit.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Madani's lover, who served with Frank in the Marines.

split.title: The Punisher S1#6
split.text: While sleeping with Madani, Billy reads her file on Frank and secretly works with William Rawlins against her investigation.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's lover, whose investigation he secretly works against.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Madani's lover, secretly working against her investigation.

verdicts.why: They sleep together at the end of S1#5, but Billy's secret work with Rawlins is first shown at the end of S1#6, so it is split out.
Billy first appears in S1#2, where he tells Madani about serving with Frank and calls him an honest man; they are not seen together until later.
At the end of S1#6 Billy plans to ambush Frank and gets into Rawlins's car. Frank realizes Billy betrayed him in S1#10, and scars his face at the carousel in S1#13.
Billy escapes in S2#3 and Madani brings Frank back to New York to deal with him. Frank kills Billy at Curtis's support group church in S2#13.

value.title: The Punisher S2#6
value.text: Krista Dumont, Billy Russo's therapist, hides him in her apartment after he comes to her for help. When he confronts her over her notes, they fight and then kiss.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's therapist, who hides him in her apartment and kisses him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Krista's patient, whom she hides and kisses.

split.title: The Punisher S2#10
split.text: Krista joins Billy's war on Frank, advising him that he can break Frank by taking away his sense of goodness.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's therapist, who falls in love and joins his crimes.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Krista's patient, whom she falls for and joins in crime.

verdicts.why: She takes him in only in S2#4 after he kills Walsh, not right after his escape, and S2#6 ends on a kiss; they first sleep together in S2#7, so 'become lovers' is cut from S2#6.

value.title: The Punisher S1#2
value.text: Billy Russo charms Sam Stein during Anvil's training session for Homeland Security, reassuring him after the exercise.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Billy charms at Anvil's training session.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The charming Anvil chief who reassures Stein at training.

split.title: The Punisher S1#8
split.text: When Stein catches a masked Russo during a shootout and unmasks him, Russo stabs him to death before he can tell anyone.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Billy charms, then stabs to death.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The charming trainer who stabs Stein to death.

verdicts.why: The split is right: Billy reassures Stein after the S1#2 training and kills him in S1#8. But at S1#2 they are on friendly terms and Billy's villainy is not shown until S1#6, so that stage's kind is ally, not enemy.

value.title: The Punisher S1#3
value.text: William Rawlins, known as Agent Orange, leads Operation Cerberus in Kandahar, where Billy Russo serves as one of its team leaders.
value.on_b_card_about_a: One of Rawlins's Cerberus team leaders.

split.title: The Punisher S1#6
split.text: Billy secretly works with Rawlins to cover up their crimes from Cerberus.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's Cerberus commander, now his partner in covering it up.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Rawlins's soldier from Cerberus, who helps cover up their crimes.

verdicts.why: The S1#3 flashbacks already show Agent Orange briefing Frank and Billy as Cerberus team leaders, so the commander part starts there. The cover-up partnership is first shown at the end of S1#6, so it is split out.

Curtis fires a shot near Mahoney's head to free Frank in S2#8. They first work together in S2#13, when Curtis hands over David Schultz, Mahoney lets him walk, and Curtis calls him to the church where Billy lies dead.
Mahoney first questions Madani after Lewis Wilson's hotel attack in S1#10, where they disagree about Castle. The jurisdiction fight over Russo is in S2#3. The attack was Wilson's, not Frank's.
On Aladna, Dar-Benn opens a jump point that draws the planet's water to Hala. The air she takes is Tarnax's.
In S1#2 Micro is shown to be David Lieberman, thought dead, secretly watching Sarah and the kids through hidden cameras.
Madani first brings Karen in for questioning about Castle in S1#5; they have no scene together before that.
Hernandez brings James to the Homeland office in S1#11, where Madani questions her about Rawlins and Cerberus. James and Hernandez confront Madani over letting Castle go in S1#13.
Stein is already Madani's partner in S1#1. Russo kills him in S1#8 during the fake operation they planned next to the office bug.
In S1#9 Lieberman finds Madani on her way to Stein's funeral and tells her about Rawlins, and she resolves to expose the truth. That is before S1#11.
The S1#3 Kandahar flashbacks show Frank and Billy meeting Gunner as a Cerberus teammate, and Frank and Gunner burying Zubair together. Gunner hides in Kentucky and dies in S1#5.
In S1#2 Frank stages the car accident, and he and Sarah bond over their lost families. In S1#4 he signs her insurance papers, and Micro gets him to promise to help the family.
In S2#5 the Schultzes, who know Frank is protecting Amy, send Pilgrim to New York to find them. Frank kills Eliza and leaves Anderson a gun in S2#13.
The S1#3 flashbacks show Agent Orange running Cerberus and Frank smashing his eye after the ambush, and Frank agrees to kill those behind Cerberus. Frank kills Rawlins in S1#12.
In the S1#3 flashback Gunner asks what Zubair is saying and Orange answers 'nothing useful'. In S1#5 Rawlins sends an Anvil unit and watches from Langley; he does not lead it.
In S1#9 Wilson claims the bombings in a letter to Karen, she publishes a rebuttal, and they argue on Ori's radio show. He takes her hostage at the hotel in S1#10.
